choosePlanFaq.q1: How does the free trial period work?
choosePlanFaq.a1: The trial lasts 30 days, with full access to platform features at no cost. After that, you can choose a subscription plan.
choosePlanFaq.q2: Can I cancel before the trial ends?
choosePlanFaq.a2: Yes, you can cancel at any time during the trial with no charges.
choosePlanFaq.q3: What happens if I do not choose a plan after the trial?
choosePlanFaq.a3: Premium access is suspended. You can continue on a free plan or subscribe later.
choosePlanFaq.q4: How can I change my plan later?
choosePlanFaq.a4: You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time in account settings.
choosePlanFaq.a5: Yes, payments are securely processed by Stripe using modern encryption standards.

section1.title: Financial Planning

anomaly.desc: The AI engine monitors every transaction and highlights out-of-pattern expenses before they become a problem.
